verdict.rationale: Viam documents the full loop. The built-in data manager captures component output to the cloud and syncs it after outages. Users create and annotate datasets and train ML models in the cloud, with an ML Training API for submitting jobs. Trained models are pushed so machines pull them automatically, with versioning, staging, rollback, canary testing and OTA model updates. missing for 10: in-depth first-party walkthrough of turning captured data into a training dataset, independent or hands-on corroboration of the train-and-redeploy loop.

support.subject: As a developer, I can feed collected robot data into model training and deploy the improved model back to the fleet

citations.quote: Data capture means the built-in data manager can capture this type’s output to the Viam cloud.
Create and annotate datasets, and train ML models in your chosen architecture, all through the cloud.
ML Training Client API: Submit and manage ML training jobs running on Viam.
Push trained models to the cloud. Machines pull them automatically and run inference locally. Version, stage, and roll back models just like code.
OTA updates for software and ML models
